hotel.name: JW Marriott Starr Pass Resort and Spa

verified_facts.text: The resort sits in a desert setting in Tucson, Arizona.
verified_facts.excerpt: Discover a desert oasis at our resort in Tucson, AZ

verified_facts.text: The Club at Starr Pass offers 27 holes of championship desert golf.
verified_facts.excerpt: 27 Holes of Championship Desert Golf

verified_facts.text: The Palmer Course nine was designed by Arnold Palmer.
verified_facts.excerpt: Designed by golf legend Arnold Palmer, this nine combines signature shot views with panoramic vistas.

verified_facts.text: The Pioneer Course's sixth fairway follows Richard Starr's original trail through the Tucson Mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pioneer’s sixth fairway follows Starr’s original trail, offering a unique connection to the land’s history

verified_facts.text: The Club at Starr Pass hosted the Tucson Open from 1987 to 1996, and Phil Mickelson won it there as an amateur in 1991.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Club at Starr Pass hosted the Tucson Open from 1987 to 1996, highlighted by Phil Mickelson’s memorable win as an amateur in 1991

verified_facts.text: Golfers frequently spot roadrunners, coyotes, bobcats, mule deer and javelinas on the course.
verified_facts.excerpt: frequent sightings of roadrunners, coyotes, bobcats, mule deer, and javelinas

verified_facts.text: The Club at Starr Pass is a Certified Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary.
verified_facts.excerpt: A Certified Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary through the Audubon Cooperative Sanctuary Program for Golf Courses

verified_facts.text: The resort's water collection includes the Starr Canyon lazy river, the Monsoon Falls water slide and the Reflection Pools.
verified_facts.excerpt: Lazily drift along the Starr Canyon River, brave the Monsoon Falls Water Slide, or lounge by the Reflection Pools.

verified_facts.text: The collection of outdoor water features is complimentary for guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience this exclusive, complimentary collection of outdoor water features available to guests

verified_facts.text: Private cabanas can be rented by the pool for shade.
verified_facts.excerpt: Escape to luxury with our cabana rentals, offering shaded comfort

verified_facts.text: Hashani Spa combines modern beauty and health technology with ancient healing techniques inspired by the region's indigenous people.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our Tucson, AZ, spa combines the latest beauty and health technology with the ancient healing techniques inspired by the indigenous people of the region.

verified_facts.text: Hashani Spa has a saline lap pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: floating in Hashani Spa’s saline lap pool

verified_facts.text: All rooms have plush bedding, marble bathrooms, sitting areas and flat-screen TVs.
verified_facts.excerpt: All of our resort rooms feature plush bedding, marble bathrooms, sitting areas and flat-screen TVs.

verified_facts.text: Some rooms have a patio or balcony with lazy river, mountain, golf or desert views.
verified_facts.excerpt: Upgrade to a luxury room with a patio or balcony boasting lazy river, mountain, golf or desert views

verified_facts.text: Each morning guests can join a traditional Native American ceremony on the Salud Terrace.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us each morning on the Salud Terrace to participate in a traditional Native American ceremony and unique Sonoran Desert experience.

verified_facts.text: The resort runs a daily guided morning hike through the Sonoran Desert.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join us for a refreshing morning hike through the beautiful Sonoran Desert.

verified_facts.text: Every evening at sunset guests gather on the Salud Terrace for a nightly tequila toast.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every evening at sunset we welcome you to gather on the Salud Terrace to watch the sunset and experience our nightly tradition - the Tequila toast.

verified_facts.text: Salud is an outdoor restaurant serving authentic Mexican cuisine, hand-crafted cocktails and fine tequilas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Take in the captivating views while enjoying authentic Mexican cuisine, hand-crafted cocktails and fine tequilas from an extensive selection at this luxury outdoor restaurant in Tucson.

verified_facts.text: Signature Grill serves Southwestern cuisine featuring Native American and Mexican dishes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience Southwestern cuisine at Signature Grill, featuring Native American and Mexican dishes made with farm-fresh produce and custom spices.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers dozens of kid-friendly things to do on site and around Tucson.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy dozens of kid-friendly things to do at our resort and around Tucson, Arizona.

verified_facts.text: Pets are not allowed at the resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at JW Marriott Tucson Starr Pass Resort & Spa.

verified_facts.text: Tucson International Airport is about 12.3 miles from the hotel.
verified_facts.excerpt: TUS is located approximately 12.3 Miles from the hotel.

verified_facts.text: The resort charges a resort fee that covers amenities including the daily rituals.
verified_facts.excerpt: Includes our daily rituals: Guided morning hikes into the Tucson Mountain Park, Native-American morning ceremony (Mitakuye Oyasin) and nightly tequila toast on the Salud Patio for up to two people.

verified_facts.text: Nearby activities include Saguaro National Park and Old Tucson.
verified_facts.excerpt: to Saguaro National Park and Old Tucson, our activities will inspire

contradictions.note: p1/p5 list all three nines (Gambler, Pioneer, Palmer) as designed by Arnold Palmer; p4 says the original 18 holes (now Pioneer and Gambler) were designed by Craig Stadler and Bob Cupp and Palmer added the third nine in 2005

sources.excerpt: The golf course officially opened in 1986, with its original 18 holes designed by Craig Stadler and Bob Cupp
